data.one_liner: Parse command line arguments directly into an annotation class using build_runner or a standalone CLI.
data.what_it_does: Parse command line arguments by annotating classes with @CliOptions() and fields with @CliOption(). It generates helper code to populate your options class from command line arguments.
use_when: You need to parse command-line arguments in Dart CLI applications or packages.
You prefer an annotation-driven approach to configuring options and flags.
avoid_when: You prefer parsing command line arguments manually using the args package directly without code generation.
strengths: Supports running as a standalone CLI or with build_runner.
Handles custom types like enums and generated helpers automatically.
weaknesses: Requires code generation steps in your workflow.
data.setup_notes: Add build_cli_annotations to dependencies and either run the standalone CLI (`dart run build_cli@`) or add build_cli and build_runner to dev_dependencies.
